description: Offline client-side logistic regression weights for geriatric ADR risk stratification, anchored to published GerontoNet ADR Risk Score predictors (Onder et al., Arch Intern Med 2010) and AGS Beers Criteria 2023 / Boustani ACB / STOPPFall.
references: Onder G, Petrovic M, Tangiisuran B, et al. Development and validation of a score to assess risk of adverse drug reactions among in-hospital patients 65 years or older: the GerontoNet ADR risk score. Arch Intern Med. 2010;170(13):1142-1148.
2023 American Geriatrics Society Beers Criteria® Update Expert Panel. J Am Geriatr Soc. 2023;71(7):2002-2010.
Boustani M, Campbell N, Munger S, et al. Aging Health. 2008;4(3):311-320; Regenstrief ACB Scale 2012.
Seppala LJ, Petrovic M, Ryg J, et al. STOPPFall. Age Ageing. 2021;50(4):1189-1199.
